item.description: arXiv:2611.05944v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the dynamics of structured laser beams carrying angular momentum (AM) as they undergo conical diffraction in photonic graphene. item.title: Pure-blue quantum-dot light-emitting diodes with minimal efficiency roll-off and high brightness
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 04 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02041-8 Quantum dots with compositionally graded shells enhance quantum-dot LED performance, achieving pure-blue emission with a peak external quantum efficiency of 23.8%, 95% of which is retained at a luminance of 50,000 cd m−2.

item.title: Low-voltage avalanche heterojunction phototransistor for infrared-to-visible upconversion
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02046-3 Researchers demonstrate infrared-to-visible upconversion using an InGaAs/InP avalanche heterojunction phototransistor. Intrinsic positive feedback provides the photocurrent for amber LED operation, producing visible emission 17,000 times brighter than incident infrared light with a breakdown voltage as low as 1.4 V.
